q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of toughened glass per square metre?
title: Toughened glass carbon footprint per sq m
short: Multiply the float glass per square metre (thickness times area times density) by the float glass supplier's figure, then add cutting, edging and the tempering furnace's electricity. Divide the unit's energy by square metres dispatched.

ul: Float glass by weight: thickness, area and about 2.5 kg per square metre per mm.
Spacers and frames if made into units.

p: Report per square metre by thickness. A 12 mm sheet carries twice the glass of a 6 mm sheet.

example.title: Worked example: toughened glass unit per sq m (one month)
lines: Plant total: 56,800 / 40,000 = 1.420 kg CO2 per sq m
Add float glass for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
